messages:
rowan: hey team — new hire here, quick Q: where do y'all keep the team docs and the page templates? I can view some pages in Notion but edit is greyed out
clare: welcome!! most of our docs live in Notion under Company Home > DevEx (Playbooks & Runbooks). templates live on the Team Templates page under DevEx. if the edit button is greyed out you probably need to be in the Docs Editors group
anil: +1. specific templates: 'New Hire Checklist v3', 'SRE Runbook (redwood)', and 'Product Spec template'. check the right sidebar when you open a page -> Templates
rowan: ok saw the Team Templates page but the top says "Can view" only. no edit button
clare: that means you're not in the "Redwood - Docs Editors" group in Okta. onboard-bot normally auto-adds folks on day 1 but sometimes it misses. ping @devex in #help or drop here and we'll fast-track
marta: clare — I can add them if you don't have time. quick steps we tell folks: 1) open the page you need 2) try clicking 'Request edit access' (top-right) 3) if that doesn't work, @clare or I can add you directly via Okta
clare: I just added rowan to the editors group, you should get a Notion email in a sec. if no email in 5min I can escalate to infra
onboard-bot: onboard-bot added rowan to "Redwood - Docs Editors" (okta)
rowan: I got the email and I can edit now :tada: — found the New Hire Checklist template. quick Q: where should product vs infra docs live so we don't duplicate?
anil: product docs -> Company Home > Product > Product Docs. infra & runbooks -> DevEx > Infra > Runbooks. team-specific guides live under each team's page but please link to the canonical index page and tag with #product or #infra
rowan: perfect. just created a runbook draft and linked it to our team page. thanks for the fast help!
clare: awesome — if you want a quick review of the runbook before it goes public, drop the link here or DM me. also FYI we have a small checklist for new pages: add owner, add tags, add a short summary, and put it in the index table (see Templates -> New Page Checklist)
rowan: will do. thanks everyone :)
thread_text_summary: New hire asks where docs and templates live in Notion; team explains locations, edit access via Okta editors group, templates names, steps to request access; onboard-bot confirms add; new hire can edit and creates runbook draft.
